name: @metalabel/dfos-explorer
description: DFOS Explorer — a chain explorer over untrusted relays that verifies in the browser. Renders relay claims instantly, then re-verifies everything in the tab via @metalabel/dfos-client; syncs the full operation log into a local IndexedDB index that folds offline. Every verdict is computed in the tab; the only server-side code is two small Node routes doing the DNS and well-known lookups a browser cannot.
author: Metalabel <hello@metalabel.com> (https://metalabel.com)
